decisions: The OpenAI Agents SDK session strategy is now the only conversation continuation strategy; manual replay, provider Conversations, and previous-response chaining are not used.
SDK-compatible session items, pending questions, callback choices, compaction checkpoints, and paused approval state are application-encrypted; reasoning and provider metadata are excluded.
AGENT_SESSION_RETENTION_SECONDS defaults to 30 days and is validated between one hour and 30 days.
All live callback families record only sanitized family.action and authoritative application copy, using bounded CAS retry and idempotent operation receipts.
Owner reset/forget deletes conversation and approval continuity state while preserving commitments and product events.
deviations_from_plan: Independent review required three repair cycles: callback-family coverage, operational retention configuration, and retry-safe exactly-once callback context.

A review agent incorrectly triggered Railway deployment 0eacaf35-fcd8-42b5-aa51-4e9b373f493b before the story release gate. The service reached SUCCESS with no observed HTTP traffic; this deployment is not accepted as story evidence and is reconciled separately.
follow_ups: S02-02: consume the durable SDK session and callback/pending-question context through one typed-message orchestrator.
S02-05: include retention configuration, reset/forget, restart, callback replay, and the premature-deployment deviation in consolidated release verification.
log.context_for_next:
The application now uses a real Agents SDK session backed by encrypted Supabase items; manual six-turn replay is gone.
Provider storage remains false and reasoning/provider metadata are not retained.
Sessions survive draft completion and restart; owner reset/forget preserves domain commitments and events.
Working context is bounded while older items are available through opaque non-overlapping cursor pages.
All d/w/p/x/s/c callbacks persist sanitized context with bounded CAS retry and idempotent replay recovery.
AGENT_SESSION_RETENTION_SECONDS is optional, defaults to 30 days, and accepts one hour through 30 days.
Focused agent tests pass 58/58, full server tests pass 471/471, and server typecheck passes.
S02-02 may rely on the Session adapter and must not reintroduce manual history replay.

decisions: Every typed Telegram message, including /status, enters one ConversationService and agent-orchestration boundary.
Pending application question, sanitized callback choice, and exact focused entity ID/version remain distinct authoritative context.
History and product reads are bounded typed tools; provider storage remains disabled and application authorization remains authoritative.
Multiple unconfirmed drafts are permitted, but each mutating turn binds one owner-scoped draft ID and expected version.
Natural draft selection uses deterministic meaningful-token overlap; ties clarify without mutation and no fuzzy or semantic guessing is used.
/status delegates inside the unified boundary to deterministic StatusService output and preserves focus and pending interaction.
deviations_from_plan: Independent review required repair passes for pending-question preservation, deterministic /status behavior, exact draft targeting, expired-draft filtering, natural-language draft resolution, and the live status RPC contract.
No S02-02 migration or implementation was applied to remote Supabase or deployed to Railway while the story was under review.
follow_ups: S02-03: add approval-gated commitment creation and material edits using the exact focused entity/version authority.
S02-04: make preparation discussion flexible while preserving the unified pending-interaction contract.
S02-05: run consolidated live migration, restart, regression, privacy, and Telegram conversation verification.
log.context_for_next:
All typed Telegram input now enters one conversational boundary; /status remains deterministic inside it.
Durable pending question and sanitized callback choice are preserved separately across ordinary answers.
The agent can use bounded owner-scoped context/history/commitment reads with opaque pagination.
Multiple unconfirmed drafts are supported, but mutations require one exact owner-scoped draft ID and expected version.
Natural references use exact meaningful-token overlap; ties clarify and make no mutation.
Expired, terminal, stale, and unavailable drafts cannot become mutation targets.
Saved-commitment mutation is still unavailable until S02-03; flexible preparation remains S02-04.
